hypotheses.T0_ordered_pair_expansion_is_exact: The 64 ordered component pairs reconstruct the native gate, write, and finite effect at fidelity at least 0.9999 everywhere.
hypotheses.T1_sixteen_pair_variations_are_sufficien: The discovery-ranked top 16 pair variations reach at least 0.80 selected held-out-template effect fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.T2_eight_pair_variations_are_insufficien: The top eight remain below 0.80 selected held-out-template fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.T3_ranked_pairs_beat_random_pair_banks: Top-16 fidelity exceeds the 95th percentile of 50 random 16-pair banks by at least 0.15 in every run and status.
hypotheses.T4_cross_component_variation_is_essentia: Retaining only the eight self-pair variations remains below 0.60 selected fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.T5_upstream_components_already_carry_mos: Mean-filling all pairs involving final attention while retaining the 7x7 upstream pair variations reaches at least 0.75 selected fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.T6_arbitrary_facts_use_a_broader_pair_pr: The selected coordinate-K90 requires at least four more ordered pairs than unselected K90 in every run.
hypotheses.T7_top_pairs_predict_answer_quotient_coo: Top 16 pairs reach answer-coordinate R-squared at least 0.70 on selected held-out-template facts in every run.
hypotheses.T8_pair_ranking_transfers_templates: Selected top-16 fidelity differs by at most 0.10 across templates in every run.
hypotheses.T9_signal_gate_passes: Every finite-effect cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
